products.name: Creality Hyper PLA
products.notes: Product page spec block (US/CA/AU store): 190-230C, hot bed 25-60C, 30-600 mm/s, fan 100%, density 1.25, 1.75+/-0.03 mm, tensile 52.99 MPa, flexural 92.38 MPa, Charpy 8.83 kJ/m2; platforms carbon-silicon, PEI, textured paper, PVP glue. Spool label matches (fan ON). Covers Hyper PLA on paper spool, Hyper PLA RFID (plastic RFID spool for CFS; identical spec block), Spool-Free Hyper PLA RFID refill and all multi-kg packs - same filament, different spool/packaging. Store copy: paper-spool version not recommended in CFS/multi-colour boxes. No drying spec on page; Creality wiki drying guide (generic PLA/PLA-CF row): Creality dryer 55C 8-12h, blast dryer 50-60C 8h; 'suggest' drying, required above 50% RH. Creality slicer profiles: K1 220C/45C bed/300 mm/s/23 mm3/s, K2 Plus 220C/50C bed/23 mm3/s, aux fan 80%.

products.name: Creality Hyper PLA Stardust
products.notes: Sold as 'Hyper PLA RFID Stardust' (UK/FR stores: 'Hyper PLA Starry'). Spec block image (AU/FR): 190-230C, bed 45-60C, 30-300 mm/s, fan 80%, density 1.27, tensile 53.3 MPa, elongation 12.1%, flexural 92.8 MPa; conventional print head, carbon-silicon/PEI plate. US page copy also gives 190-230C nozzle, 45-60C bed, 30-300 mm/s; AU/CA feed copy claims 'up to 600 mm/s' (marketing, not used). Reflective flake filler - Creality does not state abrasiveness (abrasive null). RFID spool. Drying not stated; Creality wiki drying guide (generic PLA/PLA-CF row): Creality dryer 55C 8-12h, blast dryer 50-60C 8h; 'suggest' drying, required above 50% RH.

products.name: Creality Hyper PLA Luminous
products.notes: Sold as 'Hyper PLA RFID Luminous'. US page copy: 'Print at 190-230C, bed 50-60C, speed 50-100mm/s'. CONFLICT: FR store spec block gives bed 45-60C, 30-300 mm/s, fan 100%, density 1.25, tensile 37 MPa, elongation 24%, flexural 76 MPa (fan and density taken from FR block). US values recorded. Glow pigment filler - abrasiveness not stated by Creality (abrasive null). Post-process: charge under sunlight/UV. Drying not stated; Creality wiki drying guide (generic PLA/PLA-CF row): Creality dryer 55C 8-12h, blast dryer 50-60C 8h; 'suggest' drying, required above 50% RH.

products.name: Creality Hyper PLA Lightweight
products.notes: Sold as 'Hyper PLA RFID Lightweight'. Active-foaming PLA. Spec block image: 210-270C, bed 45-60C, 40-100 mm/s, fan 100%, raw density 1.2 g/cm3, MFI 8.1 (190C/2.16kg), tensile 18 MPa, elongation 3.4%. Printed density depends on nozzle temp (Creality table): 210C 1.2 / 220C 1.08 / 230C 0.9 / 240C 0.66 / 250C 0.6 / 260C 0.54 g/cm3; marketing 'about 0.8 g/cm3'. Creality foaming guide (gallery image): nozzle 230-270C, bed 40-60C, print speed 30-60 mm/s, dry 60-80C for 4-6 h before printing; page copy: 'foaming ratio adjusts with temperature (230-270C)'. US spool label: 190-270C. Drying recorded from the foaming guide (60C lower bound, 6 h upper bound; full range 60-80C / 4-6 h). Expect to tune flow ratio down for foaming.

products.name: Creality Hyper Rainbow PLA
products.notes: EU store name 'Creality High-speed Rainbow PLA'. Spec block: 190-230C, hot bed 25-60C, 30-300 mm/s, fan 100%, density 1.25, 1.75+/-0.03 mm. Variants Spring Lake, Wild Blossom (short/long gradient). Page: store dry, use a drying box when re-using; no drying numbers - Creality wiki drying guide (generic PLA/PLA-CF row): Creality dryer 55C 8-12h, blast dryer 50-60C 8h; 'suggest' drying, required above 50% RH.

products.name: Creality Hyper PLA-CF
products.notes: Store name 'Hyper Series PLA Carbon Fibre'. Product page spec: 190-230C, heat bed 45C (single value), 50-300 mm/s. Page drying advice: 'optional but recommended' 55C for 8 h in a blast drying oven, or 75C for 12 h on a printer heatbed (recorded 55C / 8 h). CONFLICT: spool label says 200-230C, bed 25-60C, 30-350 mm/s, fan ON. Comparison table vs Hyper PLA: impact 7 vs 4.1 kJ/m2, flexural 103 vs 69 MPa, flexural modulus 3552 vs 2694 MPa, HDT-type figure 61.5 vs 55C, print speed <300 vs <100 (sic). Density not published. Carbon-fibre filled (abrasive true) but Creality does not state a hardened-nozzle requirement on the page (null). fan_pct from K2 Plus profile (100/100, aux 0); K1 profile 220C/45C/300 mm/s, fan 100, aux 80, chamber 35. CFS-C: retraction must be tuned manually.

products.name: Creality Hyper PETG
products.notes: Shop correction 2026-10-11: values from the spool label (220-260 C, bed 60-80 C, fan 50%), because the product page's 190-260 C / bed 45 C reads like PLA copy. Max speed kept at the page's 300 mm/s (label: 30-600). Product page spec block: recommended printing temperature 190-260C, heating bed 45C (single value), 50-300 mm/s, 1.75+/-0.05 mm; tensile 40-50 MPa, elongation 6-10%, E-modulus 3100-3500 MPa, impact 35-55 kJ/m2. Page tip: dry 50C for 8 h in a Creality dryer (recorded). BIG CONFLICT with the spool label: 220-260C, bed 60-80C, 30-600 mm/s, fan 50% - the label values are far more typical for PETG; page values recorded per convention, consider the label for profiles. fan_pct 50 from label; K2 Plus profile 240C/70C bed, fan 40/80%, 23 mm3/s, retraction 1.2 mm. Creality wiki generic PETG drying: 60C 8-12 h. CFS-C: retraction must be tuned manually.

products.name: Creality Hyper PETG-CF
products.notes: US store: 'Hyper PETG-CF RFID'. Product page parameter block: 240-260C, bed 70-90C, 30-300 mm/s, fan 80%, density 1.24, tensile 44.9 MPa, elongation 8.7%, flexural 88.1 MPa; print surface carbon-silicon crystal or PEI; recommended nozzle 'hardened steel or other wear-resistant nozzles'. Spool labels: 240-260C. Comparison table: impact 64.4 kJ/m2, flexural 109.3 MPa, modulus 4324 MPa, Z adhesion 9.5 kJ/m2. No drying spec on page - Creality wiki drying guide (generic PETG row): Creality dryer 60C 8-12h, blast dryer 65C 8h. (generic PETG row applied).

products.name: Creality Hyper ABS
products.notes: Product page: extruder 230-270C, hotbed 75-95C, printing speed '<350 mm/s', 1.75+/-0.05 mm, impact 19 kJ/m2, bending 48.1 MPa, HDT 76C (EU/UK page says 80C). CONFLICT: spool label 230-270C, bed 80-100C, 30-300 mm/s, fan 50-70% (fan_pct = label upper bound). Chamber 50C from K2 Plus profile (K1 table says 60C; K2 Plus profile fan 10/60%, 23 mm3/s). Enclosure: Creality K2 Plus wiki says ABS/ASA/PC/PA warp and the default profiles enable chamber heating (50-60C) with lid and door closed; K1 wiki has an ABS clogging guide. Density not published. Creality wiki drying guide (generic ABS/ASA row): Creality dryer 65C 8-12h, blast dryer 70-80C 8h.

products.name: Creality HP-ASA
products.notes: Store name 'Creality HP ASA'. Spec block (US/AU/CA/UK): printing temperature 200-300C, heat bed 50-100C, 40-300 mm/s, 1.75+/-0.03 mm. CONFLICT: headline 'print speed up to 200 mm/s' and EU/FR spec image say 40-200 mm/s (spec-table 300 recorded). FAQ image: dry 65C for 8 h in a Creality dryer before printing; use a heated bed, print in an enclosed machine with activated-carbon filtration and the chamber closed (enclosure true). Holds shape at 100C. Chamber 50C and fan max 40% from K2 Plus profile (fan 10/40%, 14 mm3/s); K1 table: 260C/100C bed/250 mm/s, fan 70%, chamber 55C. Density not published.

products.name: Creality Hyper PC
products.notes: Product page spec: density 1.19, 240-260C, hot bed 50-80C, 30-300 mm/s, tensile 53.44 MPa, elongation 4.53%, flexural 81.29 MPa (one image says 96.1 MPa), heat resistance 114.1C (copy also says 111.2C). Spool label matches (240-260C, bed 50-80C, 30-300 mm/s, fan ON - no %). Transparent only. Bed 50-80C is unusually low for PC but is what Creality publishes. No product-specific drying: Creality wiki generic PC row: drying 'must', blast dryer 80-100C 8 h (Creality filament dryer not listed for PC). Enclosure per K2 Plus wiki (ABS/ASA/PC/PA: chamber heating 50-60C, lid closed); no Hyper-PC-specific chamber value published (generic PC profile: K2 Plus chamber 50C, K1 70C).

products.name: Creality PPA-CF (Hyper PPA-CF)
products.notes: Shop correction 2026-10-11: density left blank; the published 1.06 g/cm3 is implausible for a carbon-fibre polyamide. Store name 'PPA-CF Filament'; Creality wiki/CFS sheets call it 'Hyper PPA-CF'. Spec block (AU/EU): density 1.06 g/cm3 (as published - low for a CF nylon), 280-300C, heated bed 90-105C, printing speed 100 mm/s, drying 80C 8-12 h (convection oven), 'Enclosed printing required: Yes', surfaces: high-temp plate, engineering plate, PEI. 15% carbon fibre, HDT 220C, flexural 250 MPa, water absorption 1.5%. Spool label 280-300C. CONFLICT: Creality wiki drying table lists PPA-CF at 100-120C 8-12 h (blast dryer). Not recommended in CFS (brittle, wears PTFE). Abrasive (CF) but no explicit hardened-nozzle statement on the page (null); K2 Plus wiki recommends 0.6 mm (else 0.4 mm) nozzles, <=100 mm/s, no 0.2 mm, for CF materials.

products.name: Creality HP-TPU
products.notes: Product page: recommended 210-240C, 30-120 mm/s, 1.75+/-0.05 mm; 'better with Creality direct extrusion kit'. Bed and Shore hardness not published. fan_pct from K2 Plus profile (100%); K2 Plus profile 220C/40C bed, 3 mm3/s, retraction 1.2 mm; K1 table 215C/30C bed/75 mm/s/6 mm3/s. Creality wiki: do not feed TPU through CFS; TPU of 80A or softer not recommended on Creality printers; avoid long PTFE paths. Creality wiki drying guide (generic TPU row): drying 'must'; Creality dryer 70C 8-12h, blast dryer 65-75C 8h.

products.name: Creality CR-TPU
products.notes: Sold on EU/FR stores (not US). Spool label 'Extruder Temp 210-240C'. Page copy is the HP-TPU text ('fast printing speed of 120 mm/s', 3-5x ordinary TPU) - recorded but treat with caution; K1 table gives CR-TPU 230C/30C bed/50 mm/s/3.5 mm3/s, K2 Plus 220C/40C bed/2 mm3/s, fan 100%. Bed and Shore hardness not published. Creality wiki drying guide (generic TPU row): drying 'must'; Creality dryer 70C 8-12h, blast dryer 65-75C 8h.

products.name: Creality CR-PLA
products.notes: Listed only on the CA store as 'CR 1.75mm PLA' - all colours out of stock at retrieval. Spec image: density 1.24, 190-230C, hotbed 'no heating - 60C', 40-120 mm/s, fan 100%. Creality wiki CR-PLA guide: 190-230C (start 210C), bed 50-60C (optional for small parts), 40-100 mm/s, retraction 3-8 mm (Bowden-era), fan 100%. bed_temp_min null = 'no heating'. Creality wiki drying guide (generic PLA/PLA-CF row): Creality dryer 55C 8-12h, blast dryer 50-60C 8h; 'suggest' drying, required above 50% RH.

products.name: Creality CR-PLA Matte
products.notes: Listed only on the CA store - all colours out of stock (FR listing now redirects to the collection). Spec image: extruder 190-230C, hotbed 'no heating - 60C', 40-100 mm/s; softening point 140C at the cold end (anti-clog claim). fan_pct from K2 Plus profile (100%, retraction 1.2 mm); K2 Plus wiki lists CR-PLA Matte among filaments that should be dried. Creality wiki drying guide (generic PLA/PLA-CF row): Creality dryer 55C 8-12h, blast dryer 50-60C 8h; 'suggest' drying, required above 50% RH.

products.name: Creality CR-Silk
products.notes: Spec image (AU/US CMS): extruder 190-230C, hotbed 'no heating - 60C', 40-100 mm/s, 1.75 mm; spool labels 190-230C. Density not published. fan_pct from K2 Plus profile (100%; max volumetric 10 mm3/s; K1 table 230C/45C/120 mm/s). K2 Plus wiki lists CR-Silk among filaments that should be dried. Also sold as 250 g x 8 sample pack and 10 kg packs. Creality wiki drying guide (generic PLA/PLA-CF row): Creality dryer 55C 8-12h, blast dryer 50-60C 8h; 'suggest' drying, required above 50% RH.

products.name: Creality CR-Wood
products.notes: Spec image: printing temperature 190-230C, printing speed 40-90 mm/s; bed temperature not published. Wood-powder filled PLA - Creality does not state abrasiveness (null). fan_pct from K2 Plus profile (100%; 18 mm3/s). Creality wiki drying guide (generic PLA/PLA-CF row): Creality dryer 55C 8-12h, blast dryer 50-60C 8h; 'suggest' drying, required above 50% RH.

products.name: Creality CR-PLA Carbon
products.notes: US product page: density 1.25, 195-230C, hotbed 25-60C, 40-80 mm/s, fan 100%. CA page says 190-230C. Creality's own K1/K2 tables classify CR-PLA Carbon as PLA (not PLA-CF), so material PLA; carbon/fibre content and abrasiveness not stated (abrasive null). Creality wiki drying guide (generic PLA/PLA-CF row): Creality dryer 55C 8-12h, blast dryer 50-60C 8h; 'suggest' drying, required above 50% RH.

products.name: Creality CR-PETG
products.notes: Store pages/labels: 230-250C (US listing is 'Spool-Free CR PETG' refill; also 4 kg and 250 g x 8 packs; CA listing out of stock, EU in stock). Bed, speed, fan and drying from the Creality wiki CR-PETG guide: bed 60-100C (start 80C), 40-80 mm/s, cooling 50-100%, dry at 60-65C for 4-6 h if damp (recorded 60C / 6 h), enclosure 'not mandatory but helps reduce warping', start 240C. K2 Plus profile 250C/70C bed, fan 40/80%, 16 mm3/s; K1 250C/70C/120 mm/s.

products.name: Creality Ender-PLA
products.notes: Older budget line; CA listing live but all colours out of stock, US URL now redirects to Ender Fast PLA (US copy: old Ender PLA and new Ender Fast PLA ship randomly). US CMS spec: density 1.25, 190-230C, 40-80 mm/s, fan 100%. CONFLICT: CA page/US image give single values 'printing temperature 200C, recommended speed 50 mm/s'. Bed not published. Creality wiki drying guide (generic PLA/PLA-CF row): Creality dryer 55C 8-12h, blast dryer 50-60C 8h; 'suggest' drying, required above 50% RH.

products.name: Creality Ender-PLA+
products.notes: In stock on EU/UK/FR stores (CA listing out of stock). Spec image: extruder 190-230C, hotbed 'no heating - 60C', 40-100 mm/s; spool labels 190-230C. Called 'EN-PLA+' in Creality K1/K2 tables (K2 Plus 220C/50C bed, fan 100%, 18 mm3/s). Density not published. Creality wiki drying guide (generic PLA/PLA-CF row): Creality dryer 55C 8-12h, blast dryer 50-60C 8h; 'suggest' drying, required above 50% RH.

products.name: Creality Ender Fast PLA
products.notes: US sells it as a 2 kg pack (2 x 1 kg); 1 kg CA/UK listings out of stock. CA page: 190-230C, hot bed 45-60C, 300 mm/s, tensile 46.23 MPa, bending 115.6 MPa, high fluidity '30 mm3/s'. CONFLICT: spool label 190-230C, bed 25-60C, 40-300 mm/s, fan 50-100% (fan_pct = upper bound). K2 Plus profile 220C/50C, 23 mm3/s; K2 Plus wiki lists Ender Fast PLA among filaments that should be dried. Creality wiki drying guide (generic PLA/PLA-CF row): Creality dryer 55C 8-12h, blast dryer 50-60C 8h; 'suggest' drying, required above 50% RH.

products.name: Creality Soleyin Ultra PLA
products.notes: Spec block: density 1.25, 190-230C, hot bed 45-60C, 30-300 mm/s, fan 100%, 1.75 mm (+/-0.02 mm claimed). Colour range includes 'Matte' colours (Matte Black/White/Grey, Matte Rose Stone etc.) sold under this same listing in US/UK. Vacuum packed with desiccant; no drying numbers - Creality wiki drying guide (generic PLA/PLA-CF row): Creality dryer 55C 8-12h, blast dryer 50-60C 8h; 'suggest' drying, required above 50% RH.

products.name: Creality Soleyin PLA Matte
products.notes: Separate listing on the FR store only (elsewhere matte colours sit under Soleyin Ultra PLA). FR spec block: density 1.25, tensile 41 MPa, elongation 9.2%, flexural 79 MPa, 190-230C, hot bed 45-60C, 30-300 mm/s, fan 100%; carbon-silicon or PEI plate. Creality wiki drying guide (generic PLA/PLA-CF row): Creality dryer 55C 8-12h, blast dryer 50-60C 8h; 'suggest' drying, required above 50% RH.

products.name: Creality Soleyin Basic PETG
products.notes: Spec block (UK CMS image): density 1.23, tensile 45 MPa, elongation 12%, flexural 74 MPa, 210-250C, hot bed 60-80C, 30-200 mm/s, fan 100%, conventional print head, carbon-silicon/PEI plate. CONFLICT: colour/box labels say print temp 230-250C, print speed 30-100 mm/s. Paper-spool version not recommended in CFS. Creality wiki drying guide (generic PETG row): Creality dryer 60C 8-12h, blast dryer 65C 8h.
